# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Windows integration and rendering reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds modern .NET UWP controls and experimental image comparison, alongside rendering and crash fixes. Runtime-effect uniforms start at zero, GPU texture subsets avoid sampling exterior texels, and Windows x64 image error recovery is corrected. Linux x86 native assets are no longer included.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## Platform

- **Modern .NET UWP controls** — SkiaSharp.Views.UWP adds CPU SKXamlCanvas and ANGLE-backed SKSwapChainPanel controls for net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0, declaring Windows 10.0.17763.0 as the OS minimum. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies UWP integration assets for x86, x64 and ARM64. This does not restore legacy uap10.0 support. — ❤️ [@FoggyFinder](https://github.com/FoggyFinder) ([#4540](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4540))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and produces difference images. The separate managed-only package requires opting into experimental diagnostic SKIA4001; returned difference images belong to the caller. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows x64 image error recovery** — Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors in clang-built Windows x64 natives, including malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create and PDF output using lazy non-JPEG images. ARM64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Predictable runtime-effect uniforms** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are zero-initialized, and Reset clears the existing buffer rather than allocating a replacement. Effect and mesh users no longer start with leftover uniform data. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Safer GPU texture-subset filtering** — Ganesh bilinear sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid including undefined exterior texels. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected by this option. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection** — Applies Tizen's intended blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Trim-safe MAUI SKGLView binding** — Replaces the string-path Window binding with a statically expressed binding, removing the associated trimming warning when constructing SKGLView without changing its intended behavior. — ❤️ [@bhall-ctre](https://github.com/bhall-ctre) ([#5320](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5320))

## Engine

- **Skia m159 fixes** — Updates the bundled m159 engine to the merged upstream bug-fix set. This same-milestone sync introduces no managed binding changes of its own. ([#5841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5841))
